description.value: Oshi Nori is a fast-casual sushi bar in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood offering an omakase-style hand roll experience at an open counter, where guests watch chefs craft each roll to order. The restaurant draws on the Osaka tradition of oshi-pressed sushi while emphasizing sustainably-sourced ingredients and a contemporary atmosphere. It serves both dine-in and takeout, making it a compact urban stop for cyclists passing through the downtown core.
